styles.name: White 100% cotton waist apron with centre pocket and non tangle ties — Bettys logo on the pocket
styles.desc: WAIST APRON · Pocket set centrally to the front, 28 cm x 22 cm, no centre divide · White non tangle waist ties · Bettys logo on the pocket, bottom left as worn, embroidered before make-up
styles.lectra: Model waist apron, variant Betty's — waist apron with wide pocket, cut 30 cm x 26 cm
fabrics: White 3110 100% cotton 255 gsm (P and R) — rating 1.00 m on the works order (13/6/24); All Costings has this apron on CO5001ECO, the white organic cotton, at 1.00 m, and that is what the planner cuts until told otherwise
trims: THREAD — WHITE PERMA CORE 75 20000 M CONE 32109W (Somac) — cost per metre (the works order says Coats Epic 80's white)
Printed care label (at Tibard, no Sage code): 100% cotton · 50° wash · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · do not tumble dry · dry clean. Set 4 cm down from the finished right side seam as worn.
White non tangle tape ties, cut 100 cm, heat sealed at the ends. Sage holds the white tape as the OH-branded CMP-OH-NTT-25-01 only: use that code if it is the same tape.
mfg: Double turn hem and topstitch 12 mm.
Double turn side seams and topstitch 12 mm. Insert waist ties level to the top cut edge. Insert labels in the right side seam as worn, set 7 cm down from the cut edge.
Double turn top edge and topstitch 12 mm. Edgestitch across the ends of the waist ties to secure.
Set hem to pocket: 1 cm double turned.
Edgestitch pocket to front. Pocket set centrally to width and 20 cm (8") down from the finished top edge.
Note: no V tack (triangle stitch) at the top of the pocket, as this is to be bartacked.
fin: Bartack vertically at the top of the pocket: two bartacks per apron.
styles.tol: Width of skirt ± 1.5 cm · Pocket ± 0.5 cm · Lengths ± 1.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: Bettys logo on the bottom left side of the pocket when worn. The pocket is embroidered before make-up. No centre divide to the pocket (taken off 16/10/24).
styles.note: Works order BEAP300601 (YL created for Bettys 23/2/18; model details corrected JH 16/1/19; fabric CO2001 3113 to CO5001 3110 JH 13/6/24; centre divide removed 17/10/24 JH, Di Buckley's email of 16/10/24).
